title: Contrast & ARIA remediations for floating actions and form controls
creator: Maya Patel
description: Audit and remediate accessibility issues affecting floating action buttons (FABs), form control variants (compact/tertiary), and associated token mappings. Deliverables: updated color tokens with accessible contrast ramps, ARIA role fixes for floating widgets and contextual menus, keyboard focus behavior specification, updated Storybook stories with axe checks, and VPAT evidence pages for the affected components.
comments: Maya Patel 2026-03-10: Initial audit draft uploaded to Confluence. Found 18 unique contrast failures across FAB, tertiary buttons, and disabled-form tokens when tested against 3:1 and 4.5:1 thresholds. Noted inconsistent focus ring thickness across dense and compact densities.

Diego Alvarez 2026-03-11: Reviewed the audit. Prioritize: (1) FAB primary/secondary contrast, (2) form field placeholder contrast + focus outline, (3) ARIA roles for contextual menu attached to FAB. Will coordinate with ENG on token rollout sequencing.

Maya Patel 2026-03-12: Design proposal posted: introduce two new semantic tokens -- 'interactive-foreground-high' and 'interactive-border-focus' -- to be platform-agnostic. Provided mapping guidance for legacy tokens and a migration plan: opt-in token flags for one release to avoid breaking themes.

Diego Alvarez 2026-03-13: Engineering feasibility review: ENG flagged that a global token rename will require a CSS variable shim for Dedicated deployments. ENG-44210 created to add runtime token aliasing. Added 'blessed' fallback palette to minimize runtime reflows.

Accessibility Specialist - Priya Singh 2026-03-13: Accessibility review notes — For the FAB contextual menu, swap role=menuitemcheckbox to role=menuitem when there is no checked state. Ensure aria-haspopup and aria-expanded reflect menu open state. For form inputs, placeholders must not be used as sole labels; ensure aria-label or visible label present for compact forms.

Maya Patel 2026-03-14: Updated Storybook stories to include axe-core checks and examples for keyboard-only navigation. Added a test case demonstrating focus return when a modal launched from a FAB closes. Uploaded screenshots for VPAT evidence (see Drive link).

Diego Alvarez 2026-03-14: Linked implementation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-ui/pull/4321 — PR contains token additions, updated button variants, and ARIA attribute fixes for floating action menus. Requesting frontend eng review and perf pass for CSS variable usage.

Frontend Eng - Lena Zhou 2026-03-15: Code review feedback — prefer `--rwd-interactive-foreground-high` namespace for new tokens to avoid collisions. Raised a regression risk for themes that override focus outline; added a guard to use box-shadow fallback in those cases. Also noted failing snapshot for compact form field padding; marked as follow-up.

Maya Patel 2026-03-15: Acceptance criteria checklist updated: (a) All affected components meet 4.5:1 where text size >= 14px, 3:1 for non-text UI, (b) Keyboard traversal documented and verified, (c) VPAT evidence pages updated with before/after screenshots and test steps. Scheduling a design sign-off meeting on 2026-03-18.

Diego Alvarez 2026-03-15: Blocker note — Dedicated rollout requires token aliasing implemented (ENG-44210). If token opt-in cannot be delivered before release window, we'll gate the release to avoid customer theme breakage.
